capability.summary: Describe every column in one CSV file with pandas defaults
capability.description: Reads a CSV file with pandas.read_csv defaults, runs DataFrame.describe(include='all'), and returns the resulting per-column statistics as a nested dictionary.
capability.problem_space: Quick exploratory summaries of numeric and nonnumeric columns in a single CSV table.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one CSV file path; output: JSON with describe as a column-oriented nested statistics object.
accepted_inputs: a readable CSV file parseable by pandas.read_csv with its default delimiter, header, encoding, and type inference
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pandas_describe", and describe as a column-keyed object whose values map pandas statistic names to values from DataFrame.describe(include='all'). A caught file-read, CSV-parse, dataframe-summary, or serialization exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pandas_describe", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: uses fixed pandas.read_csv defaults and exposes no delimiter, encoding, header, dtype, missing-value, or date-parsing options
include='all' mixes type-specific statistics, so inapplicable cells may serialize as NaN rather than strict JSON null
does not compute correlations, grouped summaries, custom percentiles, or inferential statistics
loads the entire CSV into memory
file access and CSV parsing failures are returned through the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Column-oriented output of pandas describe(include='all') for the loaded CSV.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
